assets.label: Isometric financing process illustration
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Primary hero illustration showing permit, acquisition, construction, and completion route
Primary request: Reference image only: generate a new standalone transparent PNG asset of a premium editorial isometric construction-financing route illustration. Cream drafting-paper base plane with faint grid, Toronto skyline sketched in light graphite at the back, four-step orange route line connecting a permit application clipboard, a single-family house acquisition vignette, a mid-rise construction site with tower crane, and a completed boutique apartment building with shield/check medallion. Fine ink outlines, muted warm greys, dark green details, small burnt-orange numbered markers, soft shadows, high-end brokerage presentation style, clean cutout edges, no UI frame, no text that needs to remain readable.
Input images: the crop is a reference image only. Generate a brand-new standalone asset; do not copy crop pixels.
Composition/framing: match the reference crop's subject, angle, aspect ratio, and visual weight.
Constraints: remove neighboring-page contamination, occluding unrelated assets, webpage framing, and collage leftovers.
Transparency/background: Generate on a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for later alpha removal; do not use #00ff00 in the subject.
Avoid: crop output, screenshot, full page mockup, browser frame, watermark, placeholder, unrelated typography.
assets.negative_prompt: Do not include Fairlend logo, header bars, form inputs, browser chrome, watermarks, blurry text, cropped edges, photorealistic people, or a full webpage screenshot.
